title: 第19章 消息灵通第20章 消息灵通二
slug: 苟住开局长生修仙只是副业
content_zh:
一壶茶水喝了，林铭也不再要，趁着夜色向着院落走去！
雪一直在下！
踩着雪花，林铭回到了自己的院落之中，拿着扫帚，简单的将院落里面一层薄薄的小雪清扫了一下，继续在院落之中修炼了一会《北冥神功》，接着练了一会《金钟罩》！
……
第二天一早，照常前往天牢上班。
先到狱卒休息处和老王他们吹牛聊天。
“林铭，老齐准备交班了，你看见他没有？！说是后天晚上下值的时候，他做东，请大家去春风楼，顺便给大家介绍一下小齐……”
一见到林铭，老王就帮忙交代着。
“那感情好！春风楼啊，可是好久没去了！”
林铭也如同不知道一样说着。
说起春风楼，一下子周边的这些狱卒就都有话题了。
程泽也是一脸羡慕的说着：
“是啊，春风楼的姑娘可是正宗的，那身段，那面容……那叫一个完美，可惜了，老齐只请吃饭，不管姑娘……”
“嘿！”
老王轻轻的在小程的脑袋上拍了一下。
“想什么呢你？！还想姑娘？！春风楼最便宜的姑娘一个晚上光是陪你吃饭就要五两银子，我们这么多人，真让老齐拿钱，就算是把他卖了他也拿不出来，怎么请？！拿什么请？！想要姑娘，自己出钱！”
“哎……那可不行。”
小程嘿嘿一笑。
“这一个晚上就是我一个月的分润，有那钱粮，我不如回家找自己的婆娘！”
“哈哈……”

众人哈哈一笑，在春风楼姑娘的问题上又聊了几句，随后转向了其他话题。
“林铭，我看刘元帅的次子进来了，刘元帅是我们大宋的大英雄，你可要关照一下，不能让他的儿子吃得太差！”
“明白！”
林铭立刻答应了下来。
“你说这陈相国也是……刘元帅在前方和北莽进行交战，他不予帮忙也就算了，还在后面捣乱……”
老王这话说出来，林铭赶紧使了一个眼色，连忙说道：
“老王别瞎说，大人的事情，哪里是你我能够说的！”
“嘿！”
老王一脸无所谓的样子，看了看身边的几人，随意的说道：
“林铭，你那么紧张做什么？！这里面又没有别人，全都是兄弟，我们私下里说说而已，没什么事的！”
“就是！”
小程也跟着说道：
“随便说说而已，没事，没事！”
见他们这种样子，林铭也不多说，拱手说道：
“那你们说，这大人的事情，我可不敢说，我还得去送饭，告辞！”
老王他们也都习惯了林铭的“胆小”，也不挽留，继续在那里高谈阔论着：
“要是我是陈相，我就要大力支持刘元帅，让他好好的打北莽……”
听着他的话，林铭的脚步走得更快了几分，快速离开了这里，他前往了后厨，到了后厨，齐大厨已经将木桶里面的饭菜准备完毕，正在做着甲乙监牢的小食盒！
“齐大厨，早！”
“林狱卒，来了！”

打了一个招呼，林铭左右手各拎着一个木桶，向着监牢之中走去。
content_en:
After drinking a pot of tea, Lin Ming stopped asking for it and walked towards the courtyard under the cover of night!
It keeps snowing!
Stepping on the snowflakes, Lin Ming returned to his courtyard. He took a broom and simply swept away the thin layer of snow in the courtyard. He continued to practice the "Bei Ming Divine Art" in the courtyard for a while, and then practiced the "Golden Bell" for a while!
…
Early the next morning, I went to work in Tianlao as usual.
First, go to the jailer's resting place to brag and chat with Lao Wang and the others.
"Lin Ming, Lao Qi is getting ready to take over his shift. Have you seen him?! He said that when he gets off duty the day after tomorrow, he will invite everyone to Chunfeng Tower and introduce Xiao Qi to everyone..."
As soon as he saw Lin Ming, Lao Wang helped explain.
"That's a great feeling! Chunfeng Tower, but I haven't been there for a long time!"
Lin Ming also said as if he didn't know.
Speaking of Chunfeng Tower, all the surrounding jailers were talking about it.
Cheng Ze also said with an envious look:
"Yes, the girl from Chunfeng Tower is authentic. Her figure, her face... she is perfect. It's a pity that Lao Qi only invites you to dinner and doesn't care about the girl..."
"Hey!"
Lao Wang gently patted Xiao Cheng on the head.
"What are you thinking about?! Still missing a girl?! The cheapest girl in Chunfeng Tower costs five taels of silver just to have dinner with you in one night. There are so many of us, so Lao Qi is really asking for the money. Even if he sells her, he can't get it out. How to treat her?! What to ask for?! If you want a girl, pay for it yourself!"
"Hey...that won't work."
Xiao Cheng chuckled.
"This one night is my monthly profit share. With that money and food, I might as well go home and find my own mother-in-law!"
"Haha..."
Everyone laughed, chatted a few more words about the girl from Chunfeng Tower, and then turned to other topics.
"Lin Ming, I see that Marshal Liu's second son has come in. Marshal Liu is our great hero in the Song Dynasty. You have to take care of him and don't let his son eat too badly!"
"Understood!"
Lin Ming immediately agreed.
"You said Chen Xiangguo is the same... Marshal Liu is fighting Beimang at the front. It's okay if he doesn't help. He is still causing trouble behind..."
When Lao Wang said this, Lin Ming quickly winked and said quickly:
"Old Wang, don't talk nonsense. There is nothing you and I can talk about about adults!"
"Hey!"
Lao Wang looked indifferent, looked at the people around him, and said casually:
"Lin Ming, why are you so nervous?! There is no one else here, we are all brothers. We are just talking in private, nothing will happen!"
"That's right!"
Xiao Cheng also said:
"Just saying it, it's okay, it's okay!"
Seeing them like this, Lin Ming didn't say much, he raised his hands and said:
"Then tell me, I don't dare to talk about this adult matter. I still have to deliver food and say goodbye!"
Lao Wang and the others were all used to Lin Ming's "timidness" and did not try to persuade him to stay. They continued to talk loudly:
"If I were Prime Minister Chen, I would strongly support Marshal Liu and let him fight Beimang well..."
After listening to his words, Lin Ming walked a little faster and left the place quickly. He went to the back kitchen. When he arrived at the back kitchen, Chef Qi had already prepared the food in the wooden barrel and was making snack boxes for Prisons A and B!
"Chef Qi, morning!"
"Warden Lin, here we come!"
After saying hello, Lin Ming walked towards the prison holding a wooden barrel in his left and right hands.
